title: Protein-protein interaction network architecture of human polygenic traits reveals domain-spanning connectivity and evolutionary pressures.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo record 21530317 (CC-BY-4.0) lists two zips: Functional 37.2 MB and Physical 34.6 MB. Downloaded Physical: 4,756 CSVs (plus macOS junk files), one per trait, 2.1 GB uncompressed. Sampled 40: each is a square gene-by-gene matrix of 449-483 gene symbols with STRING (a protein interaction database) edge scores 0.9-1.0, ~0.03% non-zero; 10,793 distinct genes across the 40. No trait names, no association strengths, no constraint values, no outcome column. Code record 21529454 is a 16 KB script zip.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That traits come from GWAS Atlas (genome-wide association study summary statistics), that gene sets are top trait-associated genes, and the connectivity-vs-selective-constraint finding; the constraint scores and trait-ID mapping are in supplementary tables S1-S11, which were not retrievable (Europe PMC supplement endpoint timed out).

a1_downloadable.note: Zenodo zips download openly (checked, Physical zip fetched). GWAS summary statistics are an external resource, not in the deposit.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked files: only per-trait adjacency matrices of STRING scores. Any target (gene-trait association, selective constraint like gnomAD LOEUF) must be constructed by joining GWAS Atlas and gnomAD by gene symbol.

a3_inputs_present.note: Gene symbols and edge weights present; no sequences, but symbols map to standard IDs.

a4_units_stated.note: Edge weights are STRING combined scores (0-1), implied rather than documented in the files.

a5_enough_rows.note: 4,756 trait matrices counted in the Physical zip, ~460 genes each; but no labels attached to them.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: 2.1 GB uncompressed per collection, very sparse
a6_fits_laptop.note: Fits easily if converted to sparse edge lists.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: 4,756 files match the abstract's 4,756 phenotypes; data statement says 4,576 traits, an inconsistency (likely typo).

a8_label_provenance.note: Edges are copied STRING scores (themselves partly text-mining/prediction-derived), and gene membership comes from MAGMA gene-level GWAS tests; any connectivity-based label is computed from these same networks.

backbone.name: ESM-2 (protein language model) for gene-level features, if a label were built

integration.partner_dataset: gnomAD constraint (LOEUF) and GWAS Atlas MAGMA gene scores
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Does a gene's network position across many traits predict its selective constraint beyond its expression and protein features?

honest_claim_h3: Nothing can be claimed from this deposit alone: it is a re-packaging of STRING subnetworks for top GWAS genes per trait, with no measured outcome attached.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use where a gene sits in trait-specific protein interaction networks to predict how strongly evolution constrains that gene.
plain_idea.train_on: For each of roughly 10,000+ genes, its connectivity across 4,756 trait-specific protein interaction networks (count verified for traits, not genes overall).
plain_idea.predict: A gene-level constraint score, which would have to be imported from gnomAD (population variant counts), not from this paper's files.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would test whether network position adds anything to known constraint predictors; but the label is external and the inputs are a reshuffle of STRING.

label_elsewhere.sources: gnomAD constraint metrics (known resource) cover ~19,000 genes; this is why the label is not specific to this paper.
label_elsewhere.why: The real label lives entirely outside this dataset, so the deposit adds little beyond STRING itself.

ml_idea: Gene-level regression of gnomAD constraint from cross-trait network connectivity; rejected because the label must be constructed externally and the inputs are derived from STRING and MAGMA outputs.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from the sampled matrix sizes; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open the files and look for any outcome column; there is none (done).

verdict_reason: A2/A8 fail: the deposit holds only 4,756 STRING-derived gene-by-gene adjacency matrices with no trait metadata or outcome; any label (constraint, association) must be built from gnomAD/GWAS Atlas, and the network features are copies of STRING scores.
